description: Galv backend is a REST service for organising battery-research metadata. Its README calls it a metadata secretary and links the project's frontend and harvester components. Operators configure a Django service and connect experiment records; users request metadata through its REST API for analysis. The output is structured battery study metadata, not a public, standardised archive of every battery measurement. Geographic coverage follows contributing laboratories. The repository licence file contains BSD-2-Clause-style source and binary redistribution terms despite GitHub's NOASSERTION classifier. A limitation is that experiments may differ in cell chemistry, protocol and measurement precision, so Galv metadata must be interpreted with their source records before being used to calibrate grid storage. The backend can support battery-parameter management for storage simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is an energy optimiser, not an experiment database. No experimental files or server instance was downloaded.
